title: RC 串联电路的电流表、电压表和功率表读数
statement: 电流表 A、电压表 V 是测有效值的电磁系仪表。功率表 W 是电动系仪表，读平均功率：它的电流线圈串在线路中，电压线圈接在结点 a 与地之间。
求三只表的读数，以及电容电压的直流分量。

notes.text: W 的电压线圈接 a 与地

i18n.en: W voltage coil: a to ground

questions.ask: 电容电压的直流分量 V_C0 = ?
questions.explain: 直流时电容开路、电流为零，R 上无压降，电源的 10 V 直流全部加在电容上。
电动系功率表读平均功率 P = I_1²R + I_3²R = (10 + 2) × 10 = 120 W；直流分量没有电流，不贡献功率。

hints: 三个分量分别单独作用。直流时电容相当于开路；k 次谐波时容抗是 1/(kωC)，3 次谐波的容抗只有 10 Ω。
电流表、电压表读有效值（各分量有效值的平方和再开方）；功率表读平均功率（各次谐波功率之和）。
电压表接在电容两端：直流分量不是零。
solution: **检查：** 只有 R 消耗功率，P = I²R = 3.464² × 10 = 120 W，与功率表读数一致。

en.title: Ammeter, voltmeter and wattmeter readings in a series RC circuit
statement: v_s = 10 + 100√2 cos(1000t) + 20√2 cos(3000t) V drives R = 10 Ω in series with C = 33.33 µF (1/(ωC) = 30 Ω at ω = 1000 rad/s).

The ammeter A and voltmeter V are moving-iron meters: they read rms values. The wattmeter W is electrodynamic and reads average power: its current coil is in the line and its voltage coil between node a and ground.
Find the three readings and the DC component of the capacitor voltage.
hints: Let each component act alone. At DC the capacitor is open; at harmonic k its reactance is 1/(kωC), only 10 Ω at the 3rd harmonic.
Ammeters and voltmeters read rms values (root of the sum of the squares of the components' rms values); a wattmeter reads the average power (the sum of the harmonic powers).
The voltmeter is across the capacitor: its DC component is not zero.
solution: **1. DC** (capacitor open): I_0 = 0, V_C0 = **10 V**, P_0 = 0.
**Check:** only R dissipates power, P = I²R = 3.464² × 10 = 120 W, the wattmeter reading.

questions.ask: DC component of the capacitor voltage, V_C0 = ?
questions.explain: At DC the capacitor is open and no current flows, so R drops nothing and the whole 10 V DC component appears across the capacitor.
An electrodynamic wattmeter reads the average power P = I_1²R + I_3²R = (10 + 2) × 10 = 120 W; the DC component carries no current and contributes no power.
